title: Teach workers to park and leaders to keep working
action: Doctrine for D1, D2 and D3. In skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md (the worker contract, section Execute): a worker with a product question it cannot answer runs `bee cells park --id <cell> --question "<question>"` and returns the new token [PARKED] (question, cell id); it never stops the lane. Add [PARKED] to the worker status-token list in the same three places that list [DONE]/[BLOCKED]/[HANDOFF]/[NOOP]: skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md, packages/bee/agents/bee-worker.md.tmpl and bee-comb.md.tmpl (description line), and packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md (final-token line). In the `[BLOCKED]` rescue ladder add one line: a [PARKED] cell is never re-dispatched or escalated; it waits for the answer. On the leader side: when a worker parks, the leader keeps dispatching ready cells; it sets `bee state waiting-on set --kind question` only when no ready cell remains in the lane, and lists every open parked question in its reply; the human's answer is recorded with `bee cells answer --id <cell> --answer "<text>"`, and the cell runs again with the answer in its brief. In skills/bee-hive/references/gates-and-delegation.md, where the waiting-on mark and questions are described, add one line that points to this rule (one home: the swarming skill). Keep each addition short. Then run the regen chain (`bee dev regen`) so rendered skill trees and the release manifest follow, and run the manifest check. The release manifest is an exclusive path: reserve it before regen. Regen also rewrites rendered skill and agent trees; list every file regen changed in the cap, and name the rendered copies as a scope deviation. path-rigor-floor prf-3 edits gates-and-delegation.md and the manifest in its own worktree; whichever merges second re-runs regen on merge.
